0022600194.text: The Phoenix Suns (2-5) host the Houston Rockets (7-2) in the eighth game of the Suns' 2026-27 season, with Phoenix 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 4 games back, after a 2-2 home record, a 0-3 road mark, and a one-game winning streak. Houston is 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, coming off a loss, and the Rockets will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while the Suns are missing Mark Williams (out after shoulder surgery) and have Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4, most recently falling 119-105 to Houston in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
